Same issue for me with v0.21.0 ``` 57:47 warning "label" used outside of binding context block-scoped-var 59:48 warning "type" used outside of binding context block-scoped-var 60:55 warning "description" used outside of binding context block-scoped-var ``` ``` let { className, option: {label, type, description}, } = this.props; return (
{label}
{type} {description}
); ```
I checked with 0.22.1 and its a bug. @ilyavolodin please update the labels.

Also happens for single level destructuring with renaming if a default value is also added. For example:

```
const { virtualSize: prevVirtualSize = 0 } = prevState;
```

I think it's +1:

``` js
const { dummy: { data, isLoading }, auth: { isLoggedIn } } = this.props;
```

```
47:21  error  "data" used outside of binding context        block-scoped-var
47:27  error  "isLoading" used outside of binding context   block-scoped-var
47:48  error  "isLoggedIn" used outside of binding context  block-scoped-var
```
I will try to fix bugs around `block-scoped-var` rule.
